summary: Complaints centre on leopard attacks and forest-department action over crops, Mughlushah waterlogging and unpaid sugarcane dues (the dues evidence is old); appreciation is limited to the Vande Bharat stop and a completed Kotdwar Road housing scheme.

positives.english: A Vande Bharat train now stops at Najibabad, making travel easier
positives.hindi: नजीबाबाद में वंदे भारत रुकने लगी, अब सफर आसान है
positives.basis: Dehradun-Lucknow Vande Bharat Express now halts at Najibabad (Najibabad Junction); it was flagged off by Uttarakhand Legislative Assembly Speaker Ritu Khanduri at the Najibabad Junction event. Article dated 10 Dec 2024.

positives.english: EWS houses and plots on Kotdwar Road in Najibabad have been completed
positives.hindi: कोटद्वार रोड पर ईडब्ल्यूएस मकान और प्लॉट बनकर तैयार हो गए
positives.basis: UP RERA registry entry shown on an aggregator: 'Kotdwar Road Yojna No-01, Najibabad 3rd Phase', promoter U.P. Awas Evam Vikas Parishad, taluka Najibabad, 111 residential plots and 100 EWS houses, status 'Completed', completion date 31 Oct 2025. This is a registry record, not a news report. Allotment and handover to beneficiaries are not confirmed. Tehsil-level, AC membership not confirmed.

positives.english: Bijnor women's herbal tea has drawn franchise demand from abroad
positives.hindi: बिजनौर की महिलाओं की हर्बल टी की विदेश से फ्रेंचाइज़ी मांग आई है
positives.basis: District-level, not this AC: the group is in Tanda Maidas Lakhi Wala village, Kotwali block of Bijnor. Started with a Rs 1 lakh loan under NRLM. The article says the US, England, Germany and France have sent franchise demand or are planned franchise targets; it does not confirm exports. Article dated 14 Jul 2026.

positives.english: * Free ration and Ujjwala gas schemes have reached villages
positives.hindi: * गरीबों के लिए राशन और उज्ज्वला गैस जैसी योजनाएं गांव तक पहुंची हैं
positives.basis: Inference: statewide welfare schemes. No Najibabad or Bijnor report on delivery of these schemes in this AC was found in 2024-26 searches. Field check needed before use.

positives.english: * Government hospital treatment and medicines are available to people
positives.hindi: * सरकारी अस्पताल में इलाज और दवा की सुविधा मिल रही है
positives.basis: Inference: no Najibabad hospital or health-facility report from 2024-26 was found; the hospital search returned only other cities. Unverified; field check needed.

negatives.english: A leopard killed a woman, and the forest department is not acting
negatives.hindi: गुलदार ने जान ले ली, वन विभाग कुछ नहीं करता
negatives.basis: Alopur village (the article says 'Jalalabad area', Bijnor district; its block and whether it falls in this AC are not confirmed): Babita Devi, 40, was taken by a leopard around 6 a.m. on 10 Sep 2026. Villagers refused to move the body until a case was registered against forest staff. BKU workers blocked the road at the Double Phatak flyover in Najibabad town (in this AC). The SDM, CO and deputy ranger came to the spot. One incident in the article; the 'repeated attacks' point is not verified from the page.

negatives.english: Heavy rain floods our lanes and homes
negatives.hindi: बारिश हुई तो मोहल्ले की गलियां और घर पानी में डूब जाते हैं
negatives.basis: Rain on Mon 4 Aug 2025 in Najibabad town: in Mohalla Mughlushah and Maqbara area, many access roads and houses had two to three feet of water; dozens of houses flooded in the Thatheron wali mosque area of Mughlushah; heavy waterlogging on Ajmal Khan Road; students had trouble reaching school. This is one event; no 2026 report found.

negatives.english: The forest department destroyed our crops and exploits farmers
negatives.hindi: वन विभाग फसल उजाड़ रहा है, किसानों का शोषण हो रहा है
negatives.basis: Fri 9 Jan 2026: Bharatiya Kisan Union (Tikait) farmers marched on foot from the Bijnor DFO office to the tehsil premises (headline names Najibabad). Farmers said the forest department destroyed their crops and that the department is exploiting farmers. District-level (Bijnor DFO), not AC-only.

negatives.english: * Sugarcane payments from the mills stay stuck for years and the mills keep delaying
negatives.hindi: * गन्ने का पैसा सालों से अटका है, मिलें टालती रहती हैं
negatives.basis: Inference: no Najibabad or Bijnor cane-dues report from 2024-26 was found. The sources are old or not specific: Gaon Connection, 13 Sep 2019, UP-wide (ISMA says UP mills owe farmers Rs 6,480 crore; the CM's 31 Aug payment promise was missed); The Quint, 27 Sep 2019, Bijnor farmers say about nine mills owe 'Rs 500 crore' 'since 2018' (farmers' claim, not verified); Amar Ujala, 30 Dec 2022, Bilai Chini Mill, Bijnor district (farmers met the District Cane Officer; mill promised Rs 1.7 crore a day; mill's tehsil not stated). Persistence to 2026 not confirmed.

negatives.english: * Drains in Najibabad stay dirty and rainwater does not drain away
negatives.hindi: * नजीबाबाद के नाले गंदे रहते हैं, बारिश में पानी निकलता नहीं
negatives.basis: Inference: no 2024-26 report on Najibabad drain condition was found. Based on the Aug 2025 Mughlushah waterlogging (negative 2) and the absence of any drain-cleaning report found. Field check needed. This is the one AC-town negative with no source.

round2.changes: Verified all sources by fetch. Confirmed AC 17 Najibabad, Bijnor, None via Wikipedia (AC covers Najibabad tehsil areas incl. Nangal KC, Jalalabad NP, Najibabad MB). Removed: Amar Ujala Tiranga Yatra (civic event, not a benefit; basis claims not verified); Amar Ujala 2021 Ganga erosion at Gauspur (no 2024-26 persistence found, dropped); Gaon Connection tag page for Nagina wood craft (Nagina is a different AC; dropped). Replaced Gaon Connection tag page with the article URL for herbal tea (now Tanda Maidas Lakhi Wala, Kotwali block, Bijnor, 14 Jul 2026; export claim corrected to franchise demand) and cane dues (article dated 13 Sep 2019). Added sourced positive: Kotdwar Road EWS/plots completion (UP RERA via aggregator). Dropped official-at-spot (not a benefit). Negative 3 wording reduced to what the page says (removed unverified 'did not let us harvest'). Negative 1 basis corrected (Alopur AC not confirmed; protest site is in Najibabad town). Positives 4-5 and negative 5 are flagged inference because no sourced 2024-26 item was found. Bilai mill article added to cane dues as old district-level context.

notes: Research limits: about 30 searches and fetches in total, so local Hindi coverage remains thin. (1) Identity confirmed from Wikipedia: AC No. 17, Najibabad, Bijnor district, reserved status None, MLA Tasleem Ahmad (SP). Wikipedia lists the AC as covering Najibabad tehsil areas KC Najibabad, Nangal, Sahanpur, Jalalabad NP and Najibabad MB; it does not list villages. Alopur (leopard death) and Nangalsoti/Gauspur could not be placed in the AC with a source, so they are not used as AC-specific. Nagina AC and Bijnor-town Kotwali block are different ACs; the herbal tea item is district-level only. (2) Gaps for field check: sugarcane dues in Najibabad mills (no 2024-26 source found; cane dues are an inference); drain condition (inference); hospital and welfare-scheme positives (inference, no source found). (3) The Ganga erosion item was dropped: its only source is 2021 and no later report was found. (4) The drain tender for Najibabad NPP (U P Jal Nigam, 2026) was seen only in search results and the infralens page returned 403, so it is not cited. (5) Not used: Kamal Nath land-record story (private land-fraud case); Gramin Bank fire and Kathara market fire (May 2026, not Najibabad-specific); Bijnor handloom weavers and the Ganga boat capsize (district, dates not shown); Bijnor chemical factory blast (district, not AC-specific).
